<?php
class NumericScalarUnionGet {
    public function __get(string $incoming): float|int {
        echo $incoming, ":";
        if ($incoming === "numeric") { return "3.5"; }
        if ($incoming === "whole") { return "12"; }
        if ($incoming === "truth") { return true; }
        if ($incoming === "bad") { return null; }
        return 2.5;
    }
}
$numeric = new NumericScalarUnionGet;
$selector = "numeric";
echo $numeric->$selector === 3.5 ? "FLOAT;" : "BAD_FLOAT;";
echo $numeric->whole === 12 ? "INT;" : "BAD_INT;";
echo $numeric->truth === 1 ? "BOOL_INT;" : "BAD_BOOL_INT;";
echo $numeric->value === 2.5 ? "DIRECT;" : "BAD_DIRECT;";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $numeric->bad === 0; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $selector === "numeric" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class FalseScalarUnionGet {
    public function __get(int|string $incoming): false|int {
        echo $incoming, ":";
        if ($incoming === "literal") { return false; }
        if ($incoming === "truth") { return true; }
        return null;
    }
}
$falsehood = new FalseScalarUnionGet;
echo $falsehood->literal === false ? "FALSE;" : "BAD_FALSE;";
echo $falsehood->truth === 1 ? "INT;" : "BAD_INT;";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $falsehood->bad === false; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class BooleanStringUnionGet {
    public function __get(?string $incoming): string|bool {
        echo $incoming, ":";
        if ($incoming === "text") { return "kept"; }
        if ($incoming === "false") { return false; }
        if ($incoming === "true") { return true; }
        return null;
    }
}
$boolean = new BooleanStringUnionGet;
echo $boolean->false === false ? "FALSE;" : "BAD_FALSE;";
echo $boolean->text;
echo ";";
echo $boolean->true === true ? "TRUE;" : "BAD_TRUE;";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $boolean->bad === false; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo "DONE;";
